name: Echo Dancer
lore: A travelling ribbon-swordsman from the Folded Coast who learned to dance between seconds. Every step leaves a memory; every memory can become another blade.

primary.name: Second Step
primary.description: A forward ribbon-sabre cut deals 22 damage. An afterimage repeats half the damage at the same spot 0.45s later. Only the last three origins are remembered, for 5s.
primary.ui_brief: Melee cut • 22 damage + a delayed echo

secondary.name: Curtain Feint
secondary.description: Return to your most recent strike origin within 400 range along a clear route. The spot you leave bursts for 12 damage within 70 reach. Strike first to set a return spot.
secondary.ui_brief: Return to last strike • burst at the spot you leave

special.name: Encore
special.description: Your last three strike origins replay in order, 0.3s apart, for 20 forward damage each. Position your memories before casting.
special.ui_brief: Replay your last three strikes • 20 damage each

passive: Lingering Applause: afterimage damage increases from 50% to 65% of the direct primary hit.

technique.name: Long Ribbon
technique.description: Trade direct damage for wider strikes and stronger delayed echoes.

attack.name: Long Ribbon
attack.description: A 110-reach ribbon cut deals 16 damage; its echo repeats the full damage after 0.45s.

final_technique.name: Dance Company
final_technique.description: Trade instant replay damage for three fragile, targetable sword companions.

attack.name: Dance Company
attack.description: Summon a dancer at each remembered origin for 6s. Each has 24 health and deals 6 melee damage. They can be attacked and killed.
